t: The EVOLite Skyworker suspension system and shell structure are designed for industrial, mountaineering, rescue and leisure activities, with a lightweight EPS liner, 4-point chinstrap and 3D-Adjustment. The shock absorbing EPS liner provides side, front and rear impact protection. The Revolution Flex wheel ratchet harness secures the helmet, eliminating pressure points to provide maximum comfort, paired with 3D-Adjustment depth settings to enable the most precise fit attainable on a safety helmet. Fitted with a replaceable Chamlon cotton sweatband. Side and rear ventilation for optimum air movement inside the shell, reducing helmet temperatures by an average 2-3 degrees.
b: Compatible With EVOGuard Visors & Sonis Ear Defenders (Sold Separately)
